subject: CHAR-NATIONAL function
notes: UPHELD — both collating paths re-derived from the spec and re-run, plus three shapes the original review did not exercise. Citation validated: §15.16.4 r1 OK via cite.py; the unspecified-character placement is §12.3.7.4 7) 1. 3. ('Any characters of the native collating sequence that are not specified in the literal phrase shall assume a position in the collating sequence that is greater than that of the highest character specified in this literal phrase') — validated, and note the real numbering is 7) 1. 3., not the 'GR7 k3' shorthand the design docs use. IDENTITY path (no PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE FOR NATIONAL, or NATIVE/UCS-4, which bind Table = null): ordinal n is code unit n-1 — golden gives C1=A for 66 and WIDE=YES for 19991 (U+4E16), LEN=01 through FUNCTION LENGTH proving one character position, result category National from the catalog row. NON-NATIVE path: re-ran three distinct alphabet shapes the earlier pass did not — (a) 'ALPHABET NAT-B FOR NATIONAL IS N"Z" THRU N"X"' (a DESCENDING THROUGH run) gives ordinals 1,2,3 = Z,Y,X and ORD(CHAR-NATIONAL(i)) = i for i in 1..5; (b) 'ALPHABET NAT-C FOR NATIONAL IS 66, 65' (the SR14c1 numeric-literal form, 1-based native ordinals) gives ordinal 1 = A and ordinal 2 = @; (c) 'ALPHABET NAT-A FOR NATIONAL IS N"B" ALSO N"A", N"C"' gives 1=B, 2=C. ISOLATION CHECK: a program declaring only an ALPHANUMERIC PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE ('ALPHABET REV IS "CBA"') leaves CHAR-NATIONAL(66) = A — the 256-entry alphanumeric weights are correctly NOT applied, because IntrinsicBinder's 'collate' flag is keyed to CHAR/ORD/MAX-MIN only and CHAR-NATIONAL takes the separate CollateNat/__COLLATE_NAT channel. The (long) wrap defect recorded under AR-15.16.3-2 cannot reach this rule: it needs |value| >= 2^63, which is always outside the sequence, so no in-range ordinal is affected. BOTH cited goldens exist on disk and were re-run green: char_national.cob covers the identity leg, alphabet_national.cob covers the non-native leg (CN1=C under 'ALPHABET REV-NAT FOR NATIONAL IS N"CBA"'). EDITIONS: Annex E establishes 2014/2023; the national type excludes 85; the 2002 lower bound is national data's introduction, not derivable from the 2023 text and not taken from IntrinsicCatalog's row.
